project_overview.subtitle: Vaše nehty — Váš osobní styl
project_overview.concept: A bespoke, sensory nail atelier website fusing editorial Swiss typography, warm cashmere & clay tones, delicate SVG art lines, soft glow mesh backgrounds, and an interactive multi-agent AI design generator + Google Calendar reservation system.
core_aesthetic_rules: No generic purple-blue AI gradients. Use warm cashmere, rose clay, champagne gold, deep espresso noir, and delicate sage.

No stock photos from photo banks or placeholder image generators. All visual textures are crafted via CSS, SVG vector art, layered ambient gradients, and real AI-pipeline generated nail-art renders upon booking.
Typography is the primary emotional carrier: 'Playfair Display' for editorial couture headings paired with 'DM Sans' for ultra-clean, readable modern body copy.
Asymmetric bento compositions with deep generous spacing, crisp 1px borders, tactile pill triggers, and subtle micro-interactions.

sections_order.layout: Asymmetric 12-column grid (7 cols left content + 5 cols right interactive SVG art canvas)
Bento showcase with distinct service tiers (Klasická manikúra, Gel lak, Modeláž nehtů, Nail art, Spa Pedikúra), price badges, time indicators, and instant 'Vybrat službu' booking trigger

Interactive bespoke nail design visualizer where client customizes shape (Mandle, Oval, Stiletto, Square), length, base finish (Glazed Donut, Velvet Matte, Rose Gold Chrome, French Ombré), and sees SVG generative preview
3-column architectural pillar cards: 1. Sterilita a bezpečnost (chirurgická úroveň), 2. Prémiové veganské gely bez toxinů, 3. Precizní péče na míru bez spěchu

Full 4-step seamless booking wizard: Step 1 (Výběr služby) -> Step 2 (Výběr data a reálného času) -> Step 3 (Kontaktní údaje a popis vysněného designu) -> Step 4 (Potvrzení, zápis do Google Kalendáře a generování AI vizualizace nehtů přes Claude/Agent pipeline)
Curated quote mosaic featuring verified customer reviews with rating stars, service tags, and dates
Dedicated accessible tab/modal allowing salon manager to view all bookings, filter by status, toggle Google Calendar sync, and inspect generated nail designs
Deep espresso footer with studio address (Vinohradská, Praha), opening hours, phone, Instagram, and rapid contact form

customer_reviews.author: Tereza K.
customer_reviews.text: Konečně nemusím nikam volat. Termín jsem měla vybraný za dvě minuty a nehty jsou pokaždé nádherné a drží přes měsíc bez jediného odštípnutí.

customer_reviews.author: Karolína M.
customer_reviews.text: Jemná práce, krásné a čisté prostředí a výsledek přesně podle mé představy. Líbí se mi možnost popsat si styl předem.

customer_reviews.author: Michaela V.
customer_reviews.text: Líbí se mi, že hned vidím volné časy a můžu se objednat i večer z mobilu. Studio M je moje srdcová záležitost.

accessibility.min_contrast: All text tokens strictly maintain >= 4.5:1 ratio against their background surfaces
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full focus-visible outlines on all triggers, modals, and date/slot buttons
accessibility.screen_readers: Descriptive aria-labels on time slot pickers, calendar days, and status badges

instructions_to_main_agent: Tailwind v4 tokens are in /app/frontend/src/index.css. Import Playfair Display & DM Sans fonts.
All copy, labels, placeholders, buttons, error messages and confirmation texts MUST be in natural, elegant Czech.

Implement the full booking flow: Service selection -> Date (interactive calendar) -> Time Slots (generated with available intervals) -> Contact form with AI design prompt -> Backend booking creation with MongoDB storage -> Simulated/Connected AI image generation preview -> Success modal with Google Calendar event simulation.
Implement the hidden/accessible Admin page (/admin or Admin tab) with full reservation list, status updating (Potvrzeno, Dokončeno, Zrušeno), and client design inspector.
Do NOT use external stock photo services. Use pure CSS, SVG illustrations of elegant hands/nails/bottles/sparkles, subtle noise textures, and live SVG nail customizers.
Ensure every interactive element has its required data-testid.
